name: Token Finder
tagline: Weekly audit that frees up spare Grok usage quota across your bot fleet
description: Once a week it goes through the routines behind your bots and looks for quota that is sitting idle. You get a plain list of where the savings would come from before anything is touched, and nothing changes until you approve it. Freed-up room means you can run more bots on the same plan.
author: CaseyChesh
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
